answer: Strongest sybil resistance: randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. A verifiable random beacon draws each agent's jury from the reputation-weighted pool, revealed only at commit time. Fakes are useless unless they repeatedly win random draws, and bribery targets a panel dissolving before deals mature. An attacker pays the stake locked per identity plus near-certain slashing when rotated panels reject gamed work, like basalt against waves, while the relic of fixed juries and its garden of sybils wither, never holding a majority each epoch.
